item.title: Your TV can see through walls (2025)
item.description:
📝 Your TV can see through walls: 2025-08-02 — 2026-02-23 This is a spectogram of the signal from a local TV station: ATSC digital TV signal. This is selective fading: The direct signal is being canceled out by a strong reflection. Because the phase of the reflection depends on frequency, this effect is not uniform over the whole signal.
🔗 Read more: https://maurycyz.com/projects/fading/
